ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 25
   D. 12.5

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 49

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

9. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 16

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 29

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

17. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

18. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 72

19. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

21. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 33
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
